verdict.rationale: Figma ships a documented official MCP server (local and hosted/remote) letting MCP clients read/write canvas content, extract design context, generate code, and generate diagrams, and a runtime probe confirms the hosted endpoint at mcp.figma.com is live and correctly speaks the MCP OAuth handshake. Missing for 10: independent (non-vendor) hands-on reports of using the MCP server with third-party agents to corroborate the first-party docs.
